# Unicode 17.0.0
# The simple case mappings of every code point that has one, from UnicodeData.txt of the Unicode
# Character Database. A line is a run of code points that move alike: `first[..last];upper;lower;title`,
# each how far its uppercase, lowercase and titlecase mapping lies from a code point of the run,
# `0` for one that maps to itself. A code point in no line maps to itself all three ways.
